entries.sourceWork: The Fellowship of the Ring (2001), Strider before Amon Hen
entries.sourceReference: The Fellowship of the Ring (2001), Strider before Amon Hen. Genuine roster performer with sixteen newly generated poses; adaptation, not verified source frames. Dark ranger cloak, weathered brown leather coat, dark hair and short beard, ranger longsword; no Anduril or Army of the Dead. Sixteen native poses visually reviewed, actual transparent alpha. Arrival/preparation/action/recovery progress. The first source had a clipped sword tip in attack4; image_gen correction retained all16 poses and restored the full blade within the canvas. Bounded engine adaptation, no certified source frames.
